in_scope.description: True if the topic is plausibly about the history, politics, or society of Finland (including related borderlands, wars, foreign relations, minorities, or figures).

scope_reason.description: One concise English sentence explaining why the topic is in scope or out of scope.

topic_fi.description: Natural Finnish translation of the topic using standard Finnish terminology.

reformulations.description: 3-5 short search queries (Finnish and English) covering key events, concepts, organisations, and people.

hyde_fi.description: 60-120-word neutral Finnish encyclopedia-style lead paragraph for the topic.

title_guesses.description: Likely exact Finnish Wikipedia article titles ordered most-central first (empty if out of scope).

keywords_fi.description: Single-word lowercase Finnish stems ending with '*' for MariaDB boolean prefix search, e.g. 'talviso*'.

angle.description: Short English phrase for the specific aspect asked about (e.g. 'causes', 'casualty numbers', 'who started it', or 'general').
